PNG Up-filter kernel, SSE2 baseline (no extra compiler flags needed on x86_64).

proc fdctPass1Sse2(pxP, midP, cosP, cfacP: ptr float64) {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
First FDCT pass: mid[v][x] += px[y][x] * CosT[v][y], then scale rows. 
proc fdctPass2Sse2(midP, resP, cosP, cfacP: ptr float64) {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Second FDCT pass: dot products summed in scalar order, then scaled. 
proc idctPass1Sse2(tmpP, midP, cosP, cfacP: ptr float64) {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
First IDCT pass: mid[y][x] += (Cfac[u] * tmp[y][u]) * CosT[u][x]. 
proc idctPass2Sse2(midP, outP, cosP, cfacP: ptr float64) {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Second IDCT pass: out[y][x] += (Cfac[v] * mid[v][x]) * CosT[v][y]. 
proc upRowSse2(curP, prevP: ptr uint8; n16: int) {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Adds prevP[0..<n16] into curP[0..<n16]; n16 must be a multiple of 16. Wrapping byte add matches the PNG spec. 
proc ycbcrRowSse2(yP, cbP, crP, rgbP: ptr uint8; n2: int) {....raises: [],

YCbCr to interleaved RGB over n2 pixels (n2 even). Same op order/grouping as the scalar converter: bit-identical.
